org_ref.name: L’Arrimage inc.
org_ref.mission: Access to the job market is at the heart of our commitment. Our mission is to support people in their job search, integration, and retention, recognizing the crucial role of work for their well-being and community belonging.
org_ref.description: L'Arrimage inc. is a non-profit organization providing specialized employment assistance services to individuals living with mental health challenges in Montreal and Laval since 1976. The organization aims for integration, follow-up, and long-term job retention, recognizing work as essential for well-being and community belonging. It collaborates with healthcare professionals and employers for successful workforce reintegration.
